subject: The 2AM podcast trick that works
preview_text: One user found a way to boost volume without touching the app. You should try it.
body_paragraphs: A user emailed me at 2AM. He said he'd been using Volume Booster Pro for months to hear a quiet podcast in the car. But one night, he forgot to open the app before plugging in his headphones. The boost still worked. He thought it was a bug.

It's not a bug. It's the auto-apply feature. The app remembers your last volume level and applies it the moment headphones connect. No opening, no tapping, no thinking. Just the slider doing its job while you do yours.

I never expected anyone to use the app this way. But now I see it: you set the boost once, connect your headphones, and the app gets out of your way. It's a quiet utility for people who just want the volume to work. No ads, no interruptions, no notifications—just the boost, silently.

Try it tonight. Turn on auto-apply in settings, then plug in your headphones without opening the app. You'll hear the difference. P.S. One user called it 'the only app that respects my attention.' That's the goal.
